# #99 — P3: DreamEngine table_filter not applied to namespace promotion candidates

State: CLOSED
Author: rodaddy
Labels: none
Created: 2026-06-11T04:07:24Z
Updated: 2026-06-11T04:32:22Z
Closed: 2026-06-11T04:32:22Z

---

## Finding
`DreamEngine._planned_actions` applies `table_filter` to tier recommendation candidates (line 247) but not to namespace scan promotion candidates (lines 259-277). A `dream_once(table="thoughts")` call would still generate promote actions for non-thoughts candidates returned by scan_namespace.

## Evidence
- `python/openbrain-memory/src/openbrain_memory/dream.py:259-277` — no table_filter check in the namespace scan loop
- `dream.py:247` — table_filter only checked in the tier recommendations loop
- Actions are dry-run-only, so no mutations leak, but reports are misleading

## Secondary
Lines 133-151 always call `tier_recommendations` for both promote/demote even when `namespace is not None` causes those candidates to be skipped at lines 241-243. Wasted server round-trips.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Apply `table_filter` to namespace promotion candidates at lines 259-277
- Skip `tier_recommendations` calls when `namespace is not None`
- Add tests verifying `table="thoughts"` scopes all action types

Post-speed-run review swarm, dream-engine reviewer, adversarial-verified.
